datasets.name: totals
queryLines:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT game_id) FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_game) AS games,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_plate_appearance) AS plate_appearances,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_pitch) AS pitches,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.dim_player WHERE is_current AND dt = (SELECT max(dt) FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.dim_player)) AS players,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT dt) FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_game) AS days_loaded,
  (SELECT max(dt) FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_game) AS latest_day

datasets.name: daily_coverage
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(dt AS DATE) AS day,
       CASE source WHEN 'mlb_statcast' THEN 'MLB (Statcast)' WHEN 'npb_spaia' THEN 'NPB' ELSE source END AS feed,
       count(*) AS plate_appearances
FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_plate_appearance
WHERE dt >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: quality
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(dt AS DATE) AS day, `check`, coalesce(`table`, '') AS table_name,
       CASE WHEN ok THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.audit_quality
WHERE dt >= '2026-01-01'

datasets.name: run_expectancy
queryLines:
SELECT runners,
       max(CASE WHEN outs = 0 THEN exp_runs END) AS outs_0,
       max(CASE WHEN outs = 1 THEN exp_runs END) AS outs_1,
       max(CASE WHEN outs = 2 THEN exp_runs END) AS outs_2,
       sum(re_pa_count) AS plate_appearances,
       base_state
FROM (
WITH v_run_expectancy_daily AS (
  SELECT
    r.league_code, r.season_year, r.base_state, r.outs, r.pa_count, r.runs, r.dt,
    CAST(r.dt AS DATE) AS game_date,
    CASE r.base_state WHEN 0 THEN 'Bases empty' WHEN 1 THEN '1st' WHEN 2 THEN '2nd' WHEN 3 THEN '1st & 2nd' WHEN 4 THEN '3rd' WHEN 5 THEN '1st & 3rd' WHEN 6 THEN '2nd & 3rd' WHEN 7 THEN 'Loaded' ELSE CAST(r.base_state AS STRING) END AS runners
  FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.run_expectancy_daily r
)
SELECT
  source.base_state AS base_state,
  source.runners AS runners,
  source.outs AS outs,
  SUM(source.runs) / NULLIF(SUM(source.pa_count), 0) AS exp_runs,
  SUM(source.pa_count) AS re_pa_count
FROM v_run_expectancy_daily AS source
WHERE source.league_code = 'MLB'
  AND source.season_year = 2026
GROUP BY source.base_state, source.runners, source.outs
) matrix
GROUP BY runners, base_state
ORDER BY base_state

datasets.name: pitch_mix
queryLines:
WITH v_pitch AS (
  WITH pa AS (
    SELECT pa_id, batting_team_id, fielding_team_id
    FROM (
      SELECT f.pa_id, f.batting_team_id, f.fielding_team_id,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.pa_id ORDER BY f.dt DESC) AS rn
      FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_plate_appearance f
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
  )
  SELECT
    p.pitch_id, p.game_id, p.pa_id, p.dt,
    CAST(p.dt AS DATE) AS game_date,
    YEAR(CAST(p.dt AS DATE)) AS season_year,
    CASE p.source WHEN 'mlb_statsapi' THEN 'MLB' WHEN 'mlb_statcast' THEN 'MLB' WHEN 'retrosheet_local' THEN 'MLB' WHEN 'npb_spaia' THEN 'NPB' WHEN 'kbo_api' THEN 'KBO' WHEN 'kbo_local' THEN 'KBO' WHEN 'lmb_local' THEN 'LMB' WHEN 'indy_local' THEN 'INDY' END AS league_code,
    p.source AS data_source,
    p.pitcher_id, p.batter_id, pa.fielding_team_id AS pitching_team_id, pa.batting_team_id,
    p.pitch_number_in_pa, p.balls_before, p.strikes_before,
    NULLIF(p.pitch_type, '') AS pitch_type,
    p.release_speed, p.plate_x, p.plate_z, p.result,
    CASE WHEN p.result IN ('swinging_strike', 'swinging_strike_blocked', 'missed_bunt', 'foul', 'foul_tip', 'foul_bunt', 'bunt_foul_tip', 'hit_into_play', 'hit_into_play_no_out', 'hit_into_play_score') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_swing,
    CASE WHEN p.result IN ('swinging_strike', 'swinging_strike_blocked', 'missed_bunt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_whiff
  FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_pitch p
  LEFT JOIN pa ON pa.pa_id = p.pa_id
)
SELECT
  CASE source.pitch_type WHEN 'FF' THEN '4-seam fastball' WHEN 'SI' THEN 'Sinker' WHEN 'FC' THEN 'Cutter' WHEN 'SL' THEN 'Slider' WHEN 'ST' THEN 'Sweeper' WHEN 'SV' THEN 'Slurve' WHEN 'CU' THEN 'Curveball' WHEN 'KC' THEN 'Knuckle curve' WHEN 'CS' THEN 'Slow curve' WHEN 'CH' THEN 'Changeup' WHEN 'FS' THEN 'Splitter' WHEN 'FO' THEN 'Forkball' WHEN 'SC' THEN 'Screwball' WHEN 'KN' THEN 'Knuckleball' WHEN 'EP' THEN 'Eephus' WHEN 'FA' THEN 'Other fastball' WHEN 'PO' THEN 'Pitchout' ELSE CAST(source.pitch_type AS STRING) END AS pitch,
  COUNT(*) AS pitches,
  AVG(source.release_speed) AS avg_mph,
  MAX(source.release_speed) AS max_mph
FROM v_pitch AS source
WHERE source.pitch_type IS NOT NULL
  AND source.season_year = 2026
GROUP BY CASE source.pitch_type WHEN 'FF' THEN '4-seam fastball' WHEN 'SI' THEN 'Sinker' WHEN 'FC' THEN 'Cutter' WHEN 'SL' THEN 'Slider' WHEN 'ST' THEN 'Sweeper' WHEN 'SV' THEN 'Slurve' WHEN 'CU' THEN 'Curveball' WHEN 'KC' THEN 'Knuckle curve' WHEN 'CS' THEN 'Slow curve' WHEN 'CH' THEN 'Changeup' WHEN 'FS' THEN 'Splitter' WHEN 'FO' THEN 'Forkball' WHEN 'SC' THEN 'Screwball' WHEN 'KN' THEN 'Knuckleball' WHEN 'EP' THEN 'Eephus' WHEN 'FA' THEN 'Other fastball' WHEN 'PO' THEN 'Pitchout' ELSE CAST(source.pitch_type AS STRING) END
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY pitches DESC NULLS LAST

datasets.name: hitters
queryLines:
WITH v_player_current AS (
  SELECT player_id, primary_name, bats, throws, primary_position, league_id
  FROM (
    SELECT p.player_id, p.primary_name, p.bats, p.throws, p.primary_position, p.league_id, p.dt,
           MAX(p.dt) OVER () AS latest_dt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_id ORDER BY p.dt DESC, p.valid_from_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.dim_player p
    WHERE p.is_current
  ) ranked
  -- Only entities in the newest snapshot. (A join to MAX(dt), or a
  -- scalar subquery, hits a DuckDB 1.5 binder error once joined.)
  WHERE rn = 1 AND dt = latest_dt
),
v_plate_appearance AS (
  WITH re AS (
    SELECT league_code, season_year, base_state, outs,
           CAST(SUM(runs) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(pa_count), 0) AS exp_runs
    FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.run_expectancy_daily
    GROUP BY league_code, season_year, base_state, outs
  ),
  pa AS (
    SELECT
      f.pa_id, f.game_id, f.dt,
      CAST(f.dt AS DATE) AS game_date,
      YEAR(CAST(f.dt AS DATE)) AS season_year,
      CASE f.source WHEN 'mlb_statsapi' THEN 'MLB' WHEN 'mlb_statcast' THEN 'MLB' WHEN 'retrosheet_local' THEN 'MLB' WHEN 'npb_spaia' THEN 'NPB' WHEN 'kbo_api' THEN 'KBO' WHEN 'kbo_local' THEN 'KBO' WHEN 'lmb_local' THEN 'LMB' WHEN 'indy_local' THEN 'INDY' END AS league_code,
      f.source AS data_source,
      f.inning, f.is_top_inning, f.batting_team_id, f.fielding_team_id, f.batter_id, f.pitcher_id,
      f.event_type, f.runs_scored_on_play, f.outs_on_play,
      f.base_state_before, f.outs_before, f.base_state_after, f.outs_after, f.runs_to_end_of_inning,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type IN ('TRUNCATED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_pa,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type IN ('1B', '2B', '3B', 'HR', 'K', 'OUT', 'DP', 'TP', 'FC', 'ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_ab,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type IN ('1B', '2B', '3B', 'HR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hit,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type = '1B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_single,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type = '2B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_double,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type = '3B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_triple,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type = 'HR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hr,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type IN ('BB') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bb,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type IN ('HBP') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hbp,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type IN ('K') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_k,
      CASE WHEN f.event_type IN ('SAC') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_sac,
      CASE f.event_type WHEN '1B' THEN 1 WHEN '2B' THEN 2 WHEN '3B' THEN 3 WHEN 'HR' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END AS total_bases
    FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_plate_appearance f
  )
  SELECT
    pa.*,
    before_state.exp_runs AS re_before,
    CASE WHEN pa.outs_after >= 3 THEN CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) ELSE after_state.exp_runs END AS re_after,
    CASE WHEN pa.outs_after >= 3 THEN CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) ELSE after_state.exp_runs END
      - before_state.exp_runs + pa.runs_scored_on_play AS run_value
  FROM pa
  LEFT JOIN re before_state
    ON before_state.league_code = pa.league_code AND before_state.season_year = pa.season_year
   AND before_state.base_state = pa.base_state_before AND before_state.outs = pa.outs_before
  LEFT JOIN re after_state
    ON after_state.league_code = pa.league_code AND after_state.season_year = pa.season_year
   AND after_state.base_state = pa.base_state_after AND after_state.outs = pa.outs_after
)
SELECT
  source.batter_id AS batter_id,
  batter.primary_name AS batter,
  SUM(source.is_pa) AS pa,
  SUM(source.is_hr) AS hr,
  SUM(source.is_hit) AS hits,
  SUM(source.is_bb) AS bb,
  SUM(source.is_k) AS k,
  SUM(source.is_hit) / NULLIF(SUM(source.is_ab), 0) AS avg
FROM v_plate_appearance AS source
LEFT JOIN v_player_current AS batter ON source.batter_id = batter.player_id
WHERE source.league_code = 'MLB'
  AND source.season_year = 2026
  AND source.data_source = 'mlb_statcast'
GROUP BY source.batter_id, batter.primary_name
HAVING SUM(source.is_pa) >= 20
ORDER BY hr DESC NULLS LAST, pa DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 25

datasets.name: standings
queryLines:
WITH v_team_current AS (
  SELECT team_id, team_name, team_abbrev, home_city, league_id
  FROM (
    SELECT t.team_id, t.team_name, t.team_abbrev, t.home_city, t.league_id, t.dt,
           MAX(t.dt) OVER () AS latest_dt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.team_id ORDER BY t.dt DESC, t.valid_from_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.dim_team t
    WHERE t.is_current
  ) ranked
  -- Only entities in the newest snapshot. (A join to MAX(dt), or a
  -- scalar subquery, hits a DuckDB 1.5 binder error once joined.)
  WHERE rn = 1 AND dt = latest_dt
),
v_team_game AS (
  WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT g.game_id, g.dt, g.source, g.game_type, g.home_team_id, g.away_team_id, g.home_score, g.away_score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.game_id ORDER BY g.dt) AS rn
    FROM gbdp.gold_gbdp.fact_game g
    WHERE (g.status IN ('Final', 'final', 'Game Over', 'Completed Early', '試合終了') OR g.status LIKE 'Final:%' OR g.status LIKE 'Completed Early:%') AND g.home_score IS NOT NULL AND g.away_score IS NOT NULL
  ),
  games AS (
    SELECT game_id, dt, source, game_type, home_team_id, away_team_id, home_score, away_score
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
  ),
  sides AS (
    SELECT game_id, dt, source, game_type, home_team_id AS team_id, away_team_id AS opponent_team_id,
           1 AS is_home, home_score AS runs_scored, away_score AS runs_allowed
    FROM games
    UNION ALL
    SELECT game_id, dt, source, game_type, away_team_id AS team_id, home_team_id AS opponent_team_id,
           0 AS is_home, away_score AS runs_scored, home_score AS runs_allowed
    FROM games
  )
  SELECT
    game_id, dt,
    CAST(dt AS DATE) AS game_date,
    YEAR(CAST(dt AS DATE)) AS season_year,
    CASE source WHEN 'mlb_statsapi' THEN 'MLB' WHEN 'mlb_statcast' THEN 'MLB' WHEN 'retrosheet_local' THEN 'MLB' WHEN 'npb_spaia' THEN 'NPB' WHEN 'kbo_api' THEN 'KBO' WHEN 'kbo_local' THEN 'KBO' WHEN 'lmb_local' THEN 'LMB' WHEN 'indy_local' THEN 'INDY' END AS league_code,
    source AS data_source,
    game_type,
    CASE WHEN game_type IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN source = 'mlb_statsapi' AND (game_type IN ('R')) THEN 'regular' WHEN source = 'mlb_statsapi' AND (game_type IN ('F', 'D', 'L', 'W')) THEN 'postseason' WHEN source = 'mlb_statsapi' AND (game_type IN ('A')) THEN 'allstar' WHEN source = 'mlb_statsapi' AND (game_type IN ('S')) THEN 'preseason' WHEN source = 'mlb_statsapi' AND (game_type IN ('E')) THEN 'exhibition' WHEN source = 'npb_spaia' AND (game_type IN ('セ・パ交流戦') OR game_type LIKE '%公式戦') THEN 'regular' WHEN source = 'npb_spaia' AND (game_type LIKE '%クライマックスシリーズ%' OR game_type LIKE '%日本シリーズ%') THEN 'postseason' WHEN source = 'npb_spaia' AND (game_type LIKE '%オールスター%') THEN 'allstar' WHEN source = 'npb_spaia' AND (game_type LIKE '%オープン戦%') THEN 'preseason' ELSE 'other' END AS season_phase,
    team_id, opponent_team_id, is_home, runs_scored, runs_allowed,
    CASE WHEN runs_scored > runs_allowed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_win,
    CASE WHEN runs_scored < runs_allowed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_loss,
    CASE WHEN runs_scored = runs_allowed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_tie
  FROM sides
)
SELECT
  source.team_id AS team_id,
  team.team_name AS team,
  SUM(source.is_win) AS w,
  SUM(source.is_loss) AS l,
  SUM(source.is_win) / NULLIF(SUM(source.is_win) + SUM(source.is_loss), 0) AS pct,
  SUM(source.runs_scored) - SUM(source.runs_allowed) AS run_diff
FROM v_team_game AS source
LEFT JOIN v_team_current AS team ON source.team_id = team.team_id
WHERE source.league_code = 'MLB'
  AND source.season_year = 2026
  AND source.data_source = 'mlb_statsapi'
  AND source.season_phase = 'regular'
GROUP BY source.team_id, team.team_name
ORDER BY pct DESC NULLS LAST, run_diff DESC NULLS LAST
